ld.description: Digestive Health Immune Support Respiratory Health Specialty Dietary Supplement Quality Promise; Tested & Trusted® Non-GMO Gluten-Free Dairy-Free Soy-Free A happy gut makes a healthy you. Formulated to promote digestive, respiratory, and immune health, The Vitamin Shoppe® brand Ultimate 10+ Probiotic capsules have 100 billion CFUs of 12 beneficial probiotic strains, plus fructo-oligosaccharides to keep the good bacteria in your digestive tract fed and flourishing. Exemplifying convenience and quality, these once-daily vegetable capsules are verified by independent 3rd party labs for potency and purity. What are CFUs? CFUs, or colony forming units, are units of measurement that express the potency of a probiotic. What are fructo-oligosaccharides? Fructo-oligosaccharides are prebiotic fiber that "feed" the probiotics present in your digestive tract.
